events.title: Cole Porter is born
events.description: Composer and lyricist Cole Porter was born in Peru, Indiana. He went on to write some of the most sophisticated songs in American popular music, and to score major Broadway musicals and Hollywood films.
events.significance: His witty, elegant songs became staples of the Great American Songbook and are still performed and recorded today.

events.title: Kingsford Smith completes the first trans-Pacific flight
events.description: Australian aviator Charles Kingsford Smith and his crew landed in Brisbane. They had flown from California in the Southern Cross, crossing the Pacific Ocean for the first time by air.
events.significance: The flight showed that long-distance air travel across vast oceans was possible. It helped bring Australia and North America closer together.

events.title: Donald Duck makes his film debut
events.description: The short cartoon The Wise Little Hen introduced the short-tempered duck to audiences. He had a small supporting role in it.
events.significance: Donald became one of Disney's most beloved characters and a global entertainment icon. He is the reason June 9 is celebrated by fans as Donald Duck Day.

events.title: Bhumibol Adulyadej becomes King of Thailand
events.description: After the sudden death of his older brother, King Ananda Mahidol, Bhumibol Adulyadej took the throne. He was a young man still studying in Switzerland.
events.significance: His reign lasted 70 years, the longest in Thai history, and he became a central unifying figure during decades of political change.
